subject: Nimbus AWS private offer — rev-share & term exception request
body:
From: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Ops <mp-orders@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nimbus private offer request — rev-share 30% & 24mo term

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Nimbus is excited about getting Redwood into our analytics marketplace bundle. We want to move forward with an AWS private offer, but we need two exceptions to the standard marketplace terms to make the economics work:

- Rev-share: requesting 30% referral rev-share for the life of the offer (our standard partner economics).
- Term: request 24-month private offer term to align with our customer procurement cycles (instead of the default 12 months).

Attached is our briefing deck and a 24-month forecast (estimates only). We can sign up to a committed minimum if that helps — we were thinking ~$600k ARR over the first 24 months.

Can your team confirm what approvals are needed on your side and an expected turnaround? AWS partner ops copied here to help with the marketplace flow.

Appreciate it,

--
Michael Lopez
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Analytics
Attachments: Nimbus_AWS_Private_Offer_Request.pdf (PDF), Nimbus_Forecast_Q4-Q8.xlsx (XLSX)

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus private offer request — rev-share 30% & 24mo term

Hi Michael — thanks for the materials and for looping AWS in. I’ve reviewed the attachments and flagged this for deal desk + leadership because the requested 30% rev-share and 24-month term are outside our standard marketplace policy.

I’m copying Marissa (AM) and Jordan (Deal Desk) to coordinate. Can you also confirm whether Nimbus expects the 30% to apply to list price or net after discounts, and whether the $600k commitment is firm or target?

I’ll get back with an internal timeline for approvals by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Soojin
Account Exec — Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Nimbus private offer request — rev-share 30% & 24mo term

Looping in my quick read for context. Key points:

- Business case: Nimbus is a strategic partner with strong reference potential; however, a 30% rev-share pushes our partner economics below thresholds where unit economics become questionable.
- Forecast: attached — customer expects tiered adoption, but numbers are backloaded (majority in months 9–18).
- Options I think we should consider:
  1) Approve a one-time elevated rev-share of 25% but with a performance gate (e.g., measured against $ spend in first 12 months).
  2) Approve 30% only if Nimbus prepays or commits to a non-refundable minimum, or we structure a sliding rev-share that reverts to standard 20% after 12 months.

Marissa recommendation: escalate to exec for signoff on a controlled concession — this is a material change. Draft P&L attached.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Nimbus_Forecast_Q4-Q8.xlsx (XLSX), redwood_marketplace_terms_v3.docx (DOCX)

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Lopez <m.lopez@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Nimbus private offer request — rev-share 30% & 24mo term

Quick deal-desk analysis:

- Baseline: standard marketplace rev-share = 20%; standard private offer term = 12 months.
- Financial impact: 30% rev-share over projected 24 months reduces Redwood net revenue by ~18% vs baseline across the forecast (model attached).
- Risk mitigations: commit minimum or prepayment; tiered rev-share that steps down; time-boxed concession.

Concrete proposal to present to leadership: Approve 25% rev-share for the first 12 months only, then revert to 20% thereafter; allow 24-month contractual term provided Nimbus signs a $600k ARR minimum commitment or 12-month prepayment. Require Legal to add an audit right and performance milestones; Finance to confirm revenue recognition treatment.

I recommend escalation to Vivek for final approval.

Jordan Blake
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: deal_desk_model_nimbus.xlsx (internal)

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus private offer request — request for exec decision

Vivek — forwarding the thread and our recommended guardrails. Short summary: Nimbus (partner) requests a 30% lifetime rev-share + 24-month private offer. Deal desk recommends a compromise: 25% for first 12 months then revert to 20%; require $600k ARR minimum or prepayment; legal and finance to finalize language.

Question for you: approve the concession as described, or do you want to counter with a stricter minimum / timebox? We need a decision to move the AWS private offer into partner ops and get a DocuSign ready.

Attachments included: Nimbus_Forecast_Q4-Q8.xlsx, redwood_marketplace_terms_v3.docx. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-897

Thanks,
Soojin

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com, finance_ops@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Nimbus private offer request — request for exec decision

Thanks for the concise summary and the options. After reviewing the forecast and the deal-desk model, I approve a constrained concession with the following conditions:

1) Rev-share: approve 25% for months 0–12, revert to standard 20% for months 13–24.
2) Term / commitment: allow a 24-month contract only if Nimbus signs a minimum $600,000 ARR commitment (documented in HubSpot and SOW) OR prepays 12 months at the agreed list price.
3) Finance & Legal: require Finance to confirm revenue recognition and Legal to add audit rights, clawback language if minimums are missed, and explicit timing for step-down to 20%.
4) One-time concession: label this a one-off (expiring onboarding concession) — any repeat requests require new exec approval.

Next steps: Jordan/legal to prepare revised marketplace amendment and DocuSign (cc finance). Marissa / Soojin to confirm final commercial terms to Nimbus and get their signature. HubSpot: please attach the DocuSign link and updated terms. I want a final summary in the deal record before execution.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_marketplace_terms_v3.docx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/complete?e=xyz123
